status: approved by owner 2026-11-20 (tiered Wilderness premium by depth; replaces the flat +25)
basis: Each anchor is rated with the 8-factor model for a TYPICAL account that attempts that content (content-appropriate stats and gear). A guide step is rated for the OWNER's account. So a published score reads: 'this is as dangerous for you as <anchor> is for a typical player doing it'.
scale_ceiling: The Fractured Archive at solo/duo scale = 100 (owner decisions: agility job ledger seq 131; calibration job ledger).
process: Calibration job (/osrs-calibrate): threat-analyst researches each anchor -> fact-verifier verifies -> risk-officer rates factors (status 'rated') -> red-team challenges ordering -> owner approves positions (status 'approved'). Re-run quarterly or after major content releases.

wilderness_premium.owner_decision: to more accurately reflect the danger add at most, 20 for deep wildy (level 30+), 15 for anything level 20+, 10 for anything 14+ and only 5 if something in wildy below level 14+ (2026-11-20; replaces the flat +25)

publishing: Headline = danger WITH standard preparation (the prep card), mapped on the ladder; 'if unprepared' = unmitigated score, shown in detail. Quests use quest_tiers. Flag floors apply to non-quest steps after calibration. Only the ceiling anchor is 100. (Owner feedback 2026-11-22 supersedes the 2026-11-21 'unmitigated headline' rule.)
